name: Civil Engineering
overview: Scripture reveals aspects of civil engineering through the careful division and description of land, as seen when the men surveyed and recorded territories for the Israelites (Joshua 18:9). The wisdom and power of God are evident in His control over the natural world, including the shaping of mountains and rivers (Job 28:9-10), as well as restraining floods and uncovering hidden treasures (Job 28:11). These passages highlight God's sovereign design and provision in the physical structures and landscapes that civil engineering seeks to understand and steward.
